sidecar_authority.rule: A sidecar entry has ZERO spine authority BY CONTRACT. It may observe any stage output and may write telemetry; it may never appear in EXPECTED_ENGINES, never be returned by EngineRunner.run(), never gate, size, veto, or modify a decision, and never own a market_question_matrix row.
sidecar_authority.why_separate_from_entries: The 17-entry spine register is reserved for engines that own a production market question (see design_only_concepts/envelope_post_entry_continuous_bounds for the precedent that protects that count). Sidecar models are EXECUTABLE and DO consume specialist evidence, so they are not DESIGN_ONLY either - they need real contracts, in particular explicit_non_goals, precisely because their output is decision-SHAPED while carrying no authority. This register is where that contract lives.
sidecar_authority.promotion_path: A sidecar may only become a spine entry via a qualification protocol plus measured deltaG001 (the TN_QUAL_V1 precedent). Registration here grants nothing.
sidecar_authority.finding: F-012 - ReplayMemory / CognitiveBus / Cluster / HMF are sidecar-only (zero spine consumption).

sidecar_entries.intent: How much capital would this opportunity deserve if every intelligence layer were weighed together?
sidecar_entries.hypothesis: A weighted blend of zone, liquidity, RR, replay, market-state and TradeNet-meta evidence separates high- from low-allocation-quality opportunities.
sidecar_entries.semantic_meaning: Advisory capital-allocation quality score - decision-SHAPED telemetry, never a decision
sidecar_entries.authority_boundary: NONE. Advisory telemetry only; never returned by EngineRunner.run().
explicit_non_goals: never gate, size, veto or modify a live decision
never be read as a calibrated probability (opportunity_score is ordinal)
never re-derive market structure - it consumes specialist outputs only
never become the sole consumer path for specialist evidence without a qualification protocol
sidecar_entries.falsification: Layer weights never separate outcomes, or the blend tracks a single dominant layer (redundant meta-layer).
sidecar_entries.notes: ARCHITECTURALLY LOAD-BEARING FOR DESIGN REVIEW: this is already a meta-model that consumes specialist evidence rather than raw features - the exact shape proposed for the BitNet redesign (see docs/architecture/bitnet-design-specification.md). Any new evidence-consumer layer must state whether it absorbs, replaces, or is scoped against HMF, or the repository ships two dormant meta-layers doing the same job.

sidecar_entries.intent: What capital quality does the composite of prior engine outputs imply for this opportunity?
sidecar_entries.hypothesis: TradeNet's p_win, combined with replay, regime and liquidity meta-context, estimates allocation quality better than p_win alone.
sidecar_entries.semantic_meaning: Meta-cognition over engine outputs; an allocation-quality score, not a win probability
sidecar_entries.authority_boundary: NONE. Feeds an advisory sidecar only.
explicit_non_goals: never size a real position despite emitting an authority tier
never be read as p_win (it consumes p_win, it does not restate it)
sidecar_entries.falsification: capital_quality_score adds nothing over the base p_win it wraps.
sidecar_entries.notes: Wraps the same TradeNet artifact that is UNWIRED on the spine (F-005). Fail-safe contract: any exception or 100ms timeout returns allocation_confidence=0.0 / QUARTER authority; torch absent or no active model => base p_win = 0.5.

sidecar_entries.intent: What happened historically in market states similar to the current one?
sidecar_entries.hypothesis: Cluster-indexed historical opportunities, temporally decayed, provide a usable base rate for the current state.
sidecar_entries.semantic_meaning: Historical base rate over similar states - institutional memory, not a forecast
sidecar_entries.authority_boundary: NONE. Read-only memory; advisory telemetry and drift audit only.
explicit_non_goals: never be read as a forward probability
never mutate state after construction (deterministic, read-only after _load)
never source its base rate from an unvalidated outcome field
sidecar_entries.falsification: Historical winrate over a cluster does not predict forward winrate for that cluster.
sidecar_entries.notes: SEMANTIC_DRIFT because its source is the opportunity JSONL stream, which F-022 established is a DETECTION stream, not a trade ledger (outcome/rr only 36.8% self-consistent). historical_winrate is therefore computed over contaminated labels. Harmless while sidecar-only; blocking for any promotion path.

sidecar_entries.intent: What advisory intelligence can be derived asynchronously without ever touching the execution plane?
sidecar_entries.hypothesis: A decision snapshot can be enriched off the hot path with zero risk to determinism or latency.
sidecar_entries.semantic_meaning: Asynchronous transport and orchestration for the advisory sidecar pipeline
sidecar_entries.authority_boundary: NONE. Write-only telemetry; the 'cognitive' key is deliberately absent from the EngineRunner return dict.
explicit_non_goals: never return anything to the execution plane
never block the hot path (non-blocking emit; drops silently when the queue is full)
never let a sidecar exception propagate into a decision
sidecar_entries.falsification: Sidecar latency or exceptions observably perturb the spine ledger.
sidecar_entries.notes: Gated by config cognitive_layer.enabled. Single background daemon thread, queue maxsize 500, WARNING above a 5% drop rate. Backpressure drops are silent by design - telemetry loss is preferred over spine interference.

design_only_concepts.note: No class RRPatternMiner; no neighbour retrieval. Module rr_pattern_miner.py is the parametric rr_trained stack only.

design_only_concepts.name: envelope_post_entry_continuous_bounds
design_only_concepts.market_question: What post-entry continuous bounds (MFE/MAE-style) follow from an entry?
design_only_concepts.note: EnvelopeNet has an EXECUTABLE OFFLINE path (research.envelope_offline.shadow.predict_heads; four independent joblib heads y_mfe_r / y_mae_r_heat / y_holding_bars / y_time_to_mfe over a 38-dim legacy vector) and is runnable via the model_runners harness as model_id 'envelope'. It is DESIGN_ONLY with respect to its PRODUCTION intent: no wired consumer, decision_weight conceptually 0, no MIAR owner row, no measured G001. Registered here rather than as an 18th engine entry because it owns no production market question; the 17-entry spine register is unchanged. Distinct from the RRPatternMiner case above, which has NO executable path at all. Reopen as a full entry only via a qualification protocol + measured deltaG001 (the TN_QUAL_V1 precedent for tradenet).
explicit_non_goals: Never be read as a calibrated probability (heads are regression outputs)
Never synthesise a composite score across heads
design_only_concepts.authority_boundary: research/observation only; grants no fusion, sizing, or production authority (CLAUDE.md 6.5)
